**[P1] Do not treat old-core omission as a safe fallback**

The OTel package still accepts core 2.4–2.6, including separately loaded layers, but those cores never add `xRayTraceId` to `InvocationInfo`. On Managed Instances this branch consequently reads the stale process-wide `_X_AMZN_TRACE_ID`, potentially assigning an execution to another invocation’s trace. Add a provider/capability version that core 2.7 supplies and reject incompatible layer hosts, or otherwise enforce core 2.7+ for this plugin; use the environment fallback only when the host can distinguish genuine runtime-carrier absence.
